title: Standard
description: A single normative Clank design/operation standard.

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. STD-UI-COM-001. Never reused. Never a CVC identifier.

domain.description: Which standards/ subdirectory this belongs to.

version.description: Incremented on every normative change. Editorial corrections do not increment it.

applies_to.description: Profile ids or explicit Clank names this standard applies to. Empty/omitted means fleet-wide.

trigger.description: Free-text applicability condition distinct from applies_to's profile/Clank scoping: describes what architectural feature or behavior a Clank must have for this standard to bind it at all (e.g. 'derives novelty from local history'), so a Clank that genuinely lacks the concept is out of scope, not in violation.

requirement.description: The normative statement itself: what must/should/may be true.

forbidden.description: Explicit anti-patterns this standard rules out.

exceptions_allowed.description: Whether a Clank may hold a recorded exception against this standard.

evidence.description: References into evidence/ supporting this standard's existence.

introduced.description: ISO 8601 date this standard was first proposed.

supersedes.description: id of the standard this one replaces, if any.
